text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout eu-west: weight blue=90%, green=10% -> shifting green to 50% now via rollout-id=canary-2026-03-15-08
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 5xx spike on eu-west edge, error-rate 30% over baseline for /v1/generate (SLO breach)
lexi (oncall): I'm paged, joining. Initial ask: how long since rollout?
deploy-bot: Rollout started 00:06:20 ago. Last change: weights updated 00:03:12 ago.
lexi (oncall): OK running quick smoke against eu-west region...
lexi (oncall): `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api-eu.redwood.inference/v1/generate | jq .` -> intermittently returns 502 / "model load failed"
marco (eng-runtime): Seeing increased model-load errors in green pool logs: OOM-like fails, but only for ~35% of requests.
sam (eng-sre): I'm seeing a routing split: some requests hit green instances behind target group tg-green-eu, others hitting tg-blue-eu but with stale nginx config that rewrites host header -> backend rejects. That explains the mixed symptoms.
nina (product): Any customer-facing impact? SupportDashboard shows 12% of EU users getting errors, some timeouts.
support-bot: Ticket aggregator: ~18 support tickets opened referencing 502 and "service errors" in EU during last 10 minutes.
lexi (oncall): Hypothesis: DNS/edge weight mismatch + partial config rollout left old proxy with incompatible header rule. Need immediate mitigation: revert traffic to blue and kill green canary. Propose featureflag toggle or weight rollback.
marco (eng-runtime): Confirmed: service-discovery returned both pool tags (blue + green) but green instances advertise model-version=v2.1 while some edge proxies expect header X-Model:v2.0 -> reject.
lexi (oncall): Action list: 1) Pause rollout (set canary=off), 2) Route all traffic to blue, 3) Flush edge caches if needed, 4) Customer comms draft, 5) Postmortem.
lexi (oncall): Flipping canary flag... `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" https://ops.redwood.internal/flags/canary-eu -d '{"enabled":false}'`
deploy-bot: Canary flag updated -> disabled.
marco (eng-runtime): Patching LB weights back to blue=100% now: `aws elbv2 modify-listener-rules ... --actions Weight=100,TargetGroupArn=tg-blue-eu` (exec in progress)
sam (eng-sre): Running probe after weight patch: `for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api-eu.redwood.inference/v1/health; sleep 1; done` -> responses stabilized to 200
lexi (oncall): Edge cache TTL was 60s, but some clients hit cached route. I'm invalidating CDN entries for api-eu via our CDN console.
marta (oncall-night): Picking up handoff in 10m if needed. Keep me posted.
marco (eng-runtime): A note: internal DNS propagation showed a 30s race where older edge boxes still pointed to green. We're adding a guard to prevent config combos across versions.
lexi (oncall): Customer impact summary for status page: "Partial API failures in EU region between 08:12-08:22 UTC affecting ~12% of requests; rollback to previous configuration completed 08:17 UTC; mitigation in progress." Thoughts?
nina (product): Good. Include that no data loss, calls retried may have succeeded. We'll post an update to status page + SOC channels.
sam (eng-sre): Monitoring shows error rate back to baseline by 08:19 UTC. Latency spike recovered by 08:21 UTC.
lexi (oncall): Assign follow-ups: marco -> runtime guard + config validation (jira: RW-INC-5471), sam -> incident runbook update about canary TTLs (RW-INC-5472), product to draft customer comms (RW-INC-5473).
marta (oncall-night): I'll take ownership for the postmortem tonight. Handoff: system stable, keep timeline + logs in RW-INC-5471.
lexi (oncall): Quick notes for handoff: root cause likely mis-synced proxy config + rapid weight shift; immediate mitigation was disabling canary flag and forcing blue=100%; rollback commands above; status page update pending.
marco (eng-runtime): Paste of key logs: ```[08:14:21] router-34: upstream=10.0.12.45: model-version=v2.1 accepted
[08:14:21] router-27: upstream=10.0.9.11: model-version=v2.0 host-header mismatch -> 502
[08:14:22] service-discovery: returned three green nodes before TTL refresh
```
lexi (oncall): We should also add an alert for "edge host-header mismatch" so triage is faster next time.
nina (product): I'll coordinate customer comms and include timeline + mitigations.
support-bot: Posting a summary to ops-status channel and creating a customer-facing incident banner draft.
lexi (oncall): Closing actions for now. If anything flips back I'll re-open. Thx all. :thumbsup:
marta (oncall-night): Acknowledged, will follow up and run the postmortem template overnight.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed: canary disabled, traffic at blue=100% as of 08:17:03 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) - followups created RW-INC-5471, RW-INC-5472, RW-INC-5473.
